name: Native Memory Management & Allocation Architecture
purpose: Design, implement, and verify custom memory allocators (Arenas, Pools, Slabs), cache line alignment (false sharing prevention), and ASan/Valgrind memory safety.

inputs.name: architecture_spec
inputs.description: Subsystem architecture and latency/throughput SLA requirements

inputs.name: memory_budget
inputs.description: Maximum memory envelope and cache footprint constraints

outputs.name: allocator_implementation
outputs.description: High-performance, aligned custom memory allocator source code

outputs.name: memory_audit_report

stop_conditions: Task acceptance criteria satisfied with evidence
Clean execution under AddressSanitizer with zero detected leaks
